新实验的正常区为均匀链，两个引线的跃迁均为t；μ以相反符号进入电子和空穴在位能。: The normal region is a uniform chain, and both leads have hopping t. μ enters electron and hole onsite energies with opposite signs. Set μ=0 and Δ=0 to compare with the existing device tool. The device-perfect preset counts one spin only, so divide this page’s conductance by 2 before comparing.
两个半无限引线通过表面Green函数进入接触自能。正常链使用精确平方根分支；超导: Two semi-infinite leads enter the contact self-energies through surface Green functions. The normal chain uses the exact square-root branch; the superconducting chain uses an analytical rational expression from the same spectral measure. Inside the gap, the right-lead Γ is zero; artificial lead broadening is not used to create propagating channels.
现有 Kanamori 课堂用统一 J 描述轨道间交换；本模块通过球谐角矩阵和: The Kanamori lessons use a common J for interorbital exchange. This module constructs the full rotationally invariant d–d Coulomb interaction from spherical-harmonic angular matrices and F⁰, F² and F⁴. F² and F⁴ control different angular channels and are not each equal to a single Hund parameter. Fully antisymmetric fermionic determinants are used.
2p 核电子被激发到3d：d⁸ 离子的初态为 p⁶d⁸，共45维，末态为 p⁵d: A 2p core electron is excited into 3d: a d⁸ ion starts in p⁶d⁸, of dimension 45, and ends in p⁵d⁹, of dimension 60. Final states include 2p SOC, direct p–d F⁰/F² and exchange G¹/G³. The d⁹ initial space has dimension 10 and the p⁵d¹⁰ final space dimension 6. In these closed-shell or single-hole configurations, p–p interactions contribute only a common constant, absorbed into the uncalibrated absorption-edge zero.
价壳 SOC 是所有单电子 l·s 的和，不能任意替换成一个总 L·S 而不投影: Valence-shell SOC is the sum of individual-electron l·s operators and cannot be replaced arbitrarily by total L·S without projection. General crystal fields and SOC mix different L and S, so the level table reports ⟨S²⟩, ⟨L²⟩ and degeneracy-averaged occupancies without imposing LS-term labels. Cubic and axial crystal fields are defined in real orbitals related exactly to the spherical-harmonic basis by a change of basis.
每条线用面积为1的Lorentz函数展宽。参数Γ为半高半宽，完整宽度为2Γ。数值: Each line is broadened with a unit-area Lorentzian. Γ is the half width at half maximum, and the full width is 2Γ. A finite energy window truncates tails; outputs give the full-axis intensity, analytical in-window intensity and numerical integral. If the sampling step is too large, the interface asks for a finer grid rather than treating smooth connecting lines as an exact peak profile.
对种子 r₀ 作用所有 Seitz 代表元，再模整格平移去重。群 2 的一般位置: Apply every Seitz representative to seed r₀, then remove duplicates modulo full lattice translations. A general position in space group 2 generates r₀ and −r₀; an inversion center generates one site. These are real-space sites in a primitive cell, not arms of a momentum star.
若 Rr₀+t 与 r₀ 只差整格向量 L，则将该代表元的平移改为 t−L，得到: If Rr₀+t differs from r₀ by an integer lattice vector L, replace the representative’s translation with t−L to obtain a site-stabilizer element that fixes r₀ exactly. Output lists both the subtracted L and the actual fixing translation.
采用周期规范：Bloch 系数只含晶格向量 T，不把轨道中心 rₐ 写进指数。平: Use the periodic gauge: Bloch coefficients include lattice vector T but omit orbital center rₐ from the exponential. Translation T_L therefore has eigenphase exp(−2πi k·L). Gauge changes alter matrix elements, so formulas from different gauges must not be mixed.
求解 Rrₐ+t=r_b+L 后，矩阵块是局域 s/p 变换乘以 exp[−2π: After solving Rrₐ+t=r_b+L, the matrix block is the local s/p transformation multiplied by exp[−2πi(R⁻ᵀk)·L]. A general operation maps the k fiber to R⁻ᵀk. Only little-group operations preserving k modulo reciprocal-lattice vectors have physical characters within the same fiber.
本站群 4 的螺旋轴沿 z。2₁ 作用两次得到一个 z 向晶格平移，故 k_z=: This site’s space group 4 has its screw axis along z. Applying 2₁ twice gives a z-directed lattice translation, so its representation squares to −I at k_z=1/2 and has eigenvalues ±i. Omitting phases when sites cross cell boundaries incorrectly gives the square +I.
第二张图画复本征值的实部与虚部，不是能带能量。k_z 增加一个倒格周期时正负标记: The second plot shows real and imaginary parts of complex eigenvalues, not band energies. The positive and negative labels exchange when k_z increases by one reciprocal period. Energy degeneracy, connectivity and insulating behavior additionally require a Hamiltonian and other constraints; this curve alone cannot establish them.
群 19 的一般轨道有四个位点。R=(1/2,1/2,1/2) 的螺旋相位产生非: A general orbit of space group 19 has four sites. Screw phases at R=(1/2,1/2,1/2) give nontrivial projective multiplication, producing two copies of the same two-dimensional little-group irrep. This dimension comes from spatial operations and translation phases, rather than a Kramers conclusion imposed by spin time reversal.
Pm−3m 的 1a、1b、3c 是位点原型。3c 三个面心位点常用于理解理想立: The 1a, 1b and 3c positions of Pm−3m are site prototypes. The three face-center sites of 3c often illustrate the oxygen sublattice of ideal cubic perovskites, but this experiment places abstract local orbitals only, without charge transfer, covalent hybridization, actual oxygen levels or occupancies.
在原点 Γ 点，局域 pₓ,pᵧ,p_z 形成 O_h 的三维极性向量表示，常用: At Γ, local pₓ,pᵧ,p_z form the three-dimensional polar-vector representation of O_h, commonly labeled T_{1u}. Its inversion matrix is −I₃ and character −3. The program still supplies only verified local D labels, without identifying them as standard database labels.
迟致格林函数的实部、虚部由同一组离散跃迁构造。η>0保证正确迟致边界，显示时产生: Real and imaginary parts of the retarded Green function come from the same discrete transitions. η>0 imposes the correct retarded boundary condition and produces Lorentzian line shapes. Matrix elements determine peak areas, while peak heights also depend on η. This computes finite-cluster single-particle spectra without orbital dipole matrix elements or instrument geometry of actual photoemission experiments.
对称半填充二聚体的q a/π=1纵向自旋探针连接基态单重态与三重态；电荷探针连接: The q a/π=1 longitudinal-spin probe of a symmetric half-filled dimer connects its singlet ground state to the triplet; the charge probe connects to the odd-parity doubly occupied state. With D=√(U²+16t²), the peak energies are (D−U)/2 and (D+U)/2, respectively. Although both follow from the same Hamiltonian, they are not one universal gap.
本实验每次选择一种自旋与一个归一探针。费米反对易关系给出移除权重为占据数n，添加: Each calculation selects one spin and one normalized probe. Fermionic anticommutation gives removal weight n and addition weight 1−n, summing to 1. Do not add an unexplained spin factor or use identical normalization for a local spectrum and a density of states summed over all sites.
二聚体t=0、U>0、(N↑,N↓)=(1,1)时，两个分居组态简并。q a/π: For a dimer with t=0, U>0 and (N↑,N↓)=(1,1), the two separated-occupancy configurations are degenerate. The q a/π=1 S_z probe takes opposite values in them, with mean zero but mean square 1/2. The connected spectrum therefore retains a zero-energy peak of weight 1/2: subtracting the mean does not remove every zero-energy response. This does not establish long-range magnetic order.
η是绘图Lorentz半高半宽，不是本计算求出的物理寿命。离散峰权重用于精确和规: η is the plotted Lorentzian half width at half maximum, not a physical lifetime calculated here. Discrete peak weights obey exact sum rules; a finite plot window omits Lorentzian tails, which are reported without renormalization. Energy spacing greater than η/3 triggers a peak-height undersampling warning. Finite spectra of two to four sites do not directly establish an infinite material’s phase diagram.
谐振子的声子数没有上限。浏览器实验把每个振子限制为0至最大声子数，完整对角化的是: A harmonic oscillator’s phonon number is unbounded. The browser experiment truncates each oscillator to occupations from 0 to a maximum and fully diagonalizes that finite matrix. The maximum input cutoff is 10; an extra comparison uses 11, giving maximum dimension 288.
+x 纯态与 ↑、↓ 等权混合在 z 方向测量都各有一半概率；前者在 x 方向确: A +x pure state and an equal mixture of ↑ and ↓ each give half probabilities in z measurements; the former gives a definite positive x result, while the latter remains random. Compare complete density matrices rather than just one set of populations.
本实验 Ω、Δ 是 H/ℏ 的系数，单位 rad/ns；时间为 ns。共振且从: Here Ω and Δ are coefficients of H/ℏ in rad/ns, and time uses ns. Starting from ↑ at resonance, the ↑ probability follows cos²(Ωt/2), reaching zero during each oscillation. Angular frequency and ordinary frequency differ by a factor of 2π.
thermalScale 只用于当前 H 的初态 Gibbs 权重。设为零时，程: thermalScale sets only the initial Gibbs weights for the current H. At zero, the program equally averages the complete ground-state subspace within a tolerance of 10⁻¹⁰ rad/ns. It does not automatically determine relaxation rates or impose detailed balance.
本实验的 ↑→↓ 与 σ_z 通道定义在固定局部基底中；有驱动或交换时，它们不一: The ↑→↓ and σ_z channels are defined in a fixed local basis. With driving or exchange, they need not induce transitions between energy eigenstates of the full H. The chosen γ₁ and γ_φ are not a complete microscopic description of a real material’s bath.
Lindblad主方程把Hamiltonian演化和每个耗散通道一起定义。对时间: The Lindblad master equation specifies Hamiltonian evolution together with every dissipative channel. For time-independent Q, d⟨Q⟩/dt=⟨L†Q⟩. Conservation of Q for every initial state requires the full operator L†Q to vanish.
有限群与SU(2)都可把对称性给定的几何结构与体系决定的约化矩阵元分开。SU(2: Finite groups and SU(2) both separate symmetry-fixed geometric structure from system-dependent reduced matrix elements. SU(2) angular-momentum triangle conditions and m selection rules belong to its own representations; SU(2) CG coefficients cannot simply be assigned to C₄ᵥ. Multiple coupling channels or repeated copies require extra channel labels and multiple reduced quantities.
两套四轨道各自按相同操作置换，表示为2A₁⊕2B₁⊕2E。两个E伙伴属于一个二维: Two four-orbital sets are each permuted by the same operations, giving 2A₁⊕2B₁⊕2E. Two E partners belong to one two-dimensional irrep, while two E copies belong to multiplicity space. Character projection gives the rank-four E isotypic subspace; projection of one seed gives only one vector.
副本间同位点跃迁和第二副本能量偏移都保持母群。在E块中，副本混合矩阵与伙伴空间单: Hopping between corresponding sites in different copies and an energy offset of the second copy both preserve the parent group. In the E block, the copy-mixing matrix forms a tensor product with the identity in partner space. Mixing thus changes the two energies while preserving each E doublet. Internal rotations of energy eigenvectors do not indicate failed symmetry.
保留C₄z和镜面得到C₄ᵥ；仅保留旋转得到C₄；仅保留xz镜面得到Cₛ；全移除得: Retaining C₄z and the mirror gives C₄ᵥ; rotation alone gives C₄, the xz mirror alone gives Cₛ, and removing both gives C₁. Average the B₁-type potential over the retained group before adding it to the Hamiltonian. The result commutes with that subgroup; special parameters may retain additional symmetry. The graph shows these four specified subgroups only.
最小破缺挑战要求使A₁—B₁混合不再被保留群禁止。枚举移除的生成元集合，实际构造: The minimal-breaking challenge asks when A₁–B₁ mixing ceases to be forbidden by the retained group. Enumerate removed-generator sets, construct the actual subgroup, average the potential and test 〈A₁|V_H|B₁〉. Parent SALCs remain a reference basis after symmetry reduction, but actual energy eigenstates can mix those labels; reassess transitions using operator matrices.
采用方格层、每个格点一个无量纲标量。位点 r=(x,y) 按 x 先变、y 后变: Use a square layer with one dimensionless scalar per site. Order r=(x,y) with x varying first and y second, embedding the plane at z=0 in three dimensions. C₄ᵥ operations do not reverse the scalar’s sign; it can represent occupancy deviations or out-of-plane displacement amplitudes. Actual crystal modes not specified here require a separate construction.
q 的分子按 N 取模，即相差母倒格矢视为同一臂。对于 N=4 的 (1,0)/: Reduce numerators of q modulo N: arms differing by a parent reciprocal vector are equivalent. For N=4 and (1,0)/4, C₄ successively produces (0,1)/4, (3,0)/4 and (0,3)/4. The star lists symmetry-related possible components; a particular pattern need not activate every arm.
回放依次展示整数旋转、星臂、正交实基、逐对叠加、真实平移和投影重建。作业目标是完: Replay shows integer rotations, star arms, orthonormal real bases, pairwise superposition, actual translations and projection reconstruction. The assignment targets the space spanned by the complete star and permits nonsingular internal basis changes; submitting only the current field generally does not span the full star.
斜条纹 f=cos[2π(x+y)/3] 的 x、y 各自周期都是 3，但 (1: Diagonal stripes f=cos[2π(x+y)/3] have separate x and y periods 3, but translation (1,−1) preserves the pattern. Thus 3×3 is a compatible rectangular cell, while a minimal oblique cell has area index only 3. The interface reports rectangular periods and the exact translation index separately.
关系图展示 G、平移群 T、当前稳定子 H、交 H∩T 与单位群；相同子群会合并: The graph shows G, translation group T, current stabilizer H, intersection H∩T and the trivial group, merging identical subgroups. Edges denote actual inclusions. The full pattern count is |G|/|H|, whereas translation-generated antiphase domains number |T|/|H∩T|. A finite quotient group does not replace standard three-dimensional space-group labels.
本模型的不同共轭对占据不同倒格点，因此相对幅度改变不同臂的权重；相对相位可改变实: Different conjugate pairs occupy different reciprocal points, so relative amplitudes change arm weights. Relative phases can change real-space patterns and stabilizers without changing individual non-self-conjugate-arm intensities. Select the unequal-amplitude preset and test whether fourfold symmetry survives.
滑移 {m_y|a_x/2} 反射 y，螺旋 {C₂x|a_x/2} 反转 y、: The glide {m_y|a_x/2} reflects y, while the screw {C₂x|a_x/2} reverses y and z. Both preserve momentum along (f_x,0,0); at general k, test whether Rk−k is a reciprocal vector. Operations outside the little group map states to another momentum and cannot directly label the same band’s states.
mτ_z⊗I 与 H₀ 的轨道非对角项反对易，破坏 G 协变但保 T。每个无质量: mτ_z⊗I anticommutes with H₀’s orbital off-diagonal terms, breaking G covariance while preserving T. Each massless branch becomes a massive square-root branch, giving a minimum direct gap 2|m| along the full line. Double-valued endpoint Kramers pairing survives. Common dispersion ε cos k shifts all energies at the same k together.
双值模型的 b I⊗σ_axis 保 G、破 T。小 b 可能只是移动交叉，所以: In the double-valued model, b I⊗σ_axis preserves G and breaks T. Small b may merely move a crossing, so the challenge uses sufficiently large b and supplies a positive gap lower bound for the whole line. The single-valued comparison term is b B(k), not an electronic Zeeman field. Gapping the original crossing position does not establish a gap along the entire path.
这里图示的是 G、T 两个指定约束及其删除关系，先模去平移与双群中心；标签商的阶: The diagram shows the two specified constraints G and T and their removal, after quotienting translations and the double-group center. The label quotient has order 4, 2 or 1. Matrices still retain the actual G² translation phase and T² minus sign. This is not a full subgroup catalog of arbitrary three-dimensional space groups.
在指定 k 求最低能量的全部本征矢，按列提交矩阵。简并时不同数值求解器可产生不同: Find every lowest-energy eigenvector at the selected k and submit them as matrix columns. At degeneracy, different numerical solvers may choose different bases; overall phases and internal unitary mixing are equivalent. Check dimension, orthogonal projector and invariance of the subspace under H rather than demanding entrywise-identical eigenvectors.
以母相晶格 Lp 作为参考度量，u_ref=Δf Lp。晶格的变形梯度 F=(L: Use the parent lattice Lp as the reference metric, with u_ref=Δf Lp. The lattice deformation gradient F=(Lp⁻¹Ld)ᵀ gives homogeneous strain E=(FᵀF−I)/2; internal displacements in the actual distorted cell are u_ref Fᵀ. Mode projection uses the parent reference frame. Overall translation may be removed using the arithmetic mean over atoms rather than a mass-weighted center of mass.
b1、b2>0 且 c>−2√(b1b2) 保证四次项严格稳定，正 c 没有上限: b1,b2>0 and c>−2√(b1b2) guarantee a strictly stable quartic term, with no upper limit on positive c. Below the negative boundary the energy is unbounded below; at that boundary the quadratic term also requires checking. The tool reports boundedness and continuously degenerate solutions separately rather than treating the lowest plotted point as a stable phase. At positive c=2√(b1b2), particular quadratic coefficients can also yield an ellipse of minima.
铁磁链采用负号交换 Hamiltonian，J>0；Δ≥1 为易轴 XXZ 交换: The ferromagnetic chain uses an exchange Hamiltonian with an overall minus sign and J>0; Δ≥1 is easy-axis XXZ exchange anisotropy. h is a Zeeman energy in meV that already includes gμB, not a magnetic field in Tesla.
每个体积都要有静态能量和振动自由能，使用相同的计算胞计量、原子数、温度网格和能量: Every volume requires static energy and vibrational free energy with the same cell normalization, atom count, temperature grid and energy units. Each volume must have its own corresponding phonon calculation; one DOS cannot simply be assigned repeatedly to different volumes.
选择 xy、yz、xz、x²−y²、3z²−r² 五个归一实 d 球谐，每个配上: Choose five normalized real d spherical harmonics xy, yz, xz, x²−y² and 3z²−r², each with ↑ and ↓. The ten-dimensional matrix describes ten single-electron basis states, not ten electrons automatically present in the system. Orbital colors show signs of real basis functions; radius illustrates angular distributions without an actual atomic radial scale.
理想 Oh 背景下，xy、yz、xz 构成 t₂g，另两个轨道构成 e_g。设: In ideal Oh coordination, xy,yz,xz form t₂g and the other two orbitals form e_g. Define Δ=E(e_g)−E(t₂g)>0 and place the five-orbital energy barycenter at zero to fix both sets of energies. Changing Δ changes energies only, not ligand bond lengths automatically.
在本约定中，四方项按指定对角系数作用于五个 d 轨道；Oh 的 Δ 等于 10D: Here tetragonal terms act on the five d orbitals with specified diagonal coefficients, and Δ=10Dq for Oh. Ds/Dt are not fitted from ligand coordinates; their signs cannot be called elongation or compression independently of the convention. The 3D ligands still show an ideal background. Connecting distortions requires a separate mapping from displacements to crystal-field parameters.
角动量矩阵从 l=2 的升降算符转换到与三维图一致的实轨道基，L、S 以 ℏ 为: Angular-momentum matrices are transformed from l=2 raising/lowering operators into the real-orbital basis used by the 3D plot. L and S use units of ℏ, and λ uses eV. At zero crystal field, j=l±s gives an independently checkable analytical limit. Negative λ reverses the two level-group orderings without changing matrix or angular-momentum conventions.
电子矩阵本征值为 ±|g|ρ，其中 ρ 是二维坐标半径。加上弹性能，得到上、下两: Electronic eigenvalues are ±|g|ρ, where ρ is the radius in the two-dimensional coordinate space. Adding elastic energy gives upper and lower adiabatic surfaces. For g≠0, the origin is a conical intersection; its lower state is not unique, so an arbitrary numerical eigenvector has no unique orbital interpretation.
下势能面的径向导数为 Kρ−|g|，因此极小半径是 |g|/K，能量相对原点降低: The lower surface’s radial derivative is Kρ−|g|, so its minimum radius is |g|/K and its energy lies g²/(2K) below the origin. The program reports this analytical global minimum even outside the current 2D window, and the radial curve includes that radius. At g=0, the origin is the only minimum.
封闭有限链只有离散本征能级。输运问题还需要左、右电极作为粒子库；在本模型中，两根: A closed finite chain has discrete eigenlevels. Transport additionally needs left and right electrodes as particle reservoirs. Here two identical semi-infinite uniform chains connect to the first and last sites of a finite scattering region, either uniform or an alternating-bond SSH chain. Hamiltonian off-diagonal hopping elements carry the minus sign −t.
均匀引线的能带范围为ε₀±2t₀。其迟致表面Green函数必须选择虚部非正、远离: The uniform lead band spans ε₀±2t₀. Its retarded surface Green function must have nonpositive imaginary part and approach 1/E far from the band. Contact self-energies encode open boundaries in the finite matrix; contact hopping v is not an independent relaxation time.
散射区跃迁、在位能和接触都与电极匹配时，带内没有物理反射，η→0时T=1。数值正: If scattering-region hoppings, onsite energies and contacts match the electrodes, there is no physical in-band reflection and T=1 as η→0. A positive numerical imaginary part gives small artificial absorption, shown together with conservation residuals. Group velocity vanishes exactly at a band edge, so that point is not treated as an open propagating channel.
在匹配均匀链中加入一个在位势V，有限的反射来自散射振幅干涉。对t=1、其他在位能: Adding an onsite potential V to a matched uniform chain produces finite reflection through interference of scattering amplitudes. For a single-site barrier with t=1 and all other onsite energies zero, analytical transmission independently checks the program. Moving that barrier does not change its transmission probability on an infinite uniform background.
这里第0条键连接站点0和1，定义为胞内键t₁=t×dimerRatio，下一条为: Bond 0 connects sites 0 and 1 and is the intracell bond t₁=t×dimerRatio; the next is the intercell bond t₂=t. An even-site chain with weak intracell bonds may have low-energy edge states. At finite length, the two endpoint wavefunctions overlap, so their energies generally are not exactly zero. An overall minus sign on hopping does not change the SSH Zak phase modulo 2π, but comparisons still require consistent orbital and cell conventions.
两端边界强制存在一面壁，反对称约束固定中心。此实验求固定中心约束的静态驻点，同时: The two boundary conditions force one wall to exist, while antisymmetry pins its center. This experiment finds a center-constrained static stationary point and also checks the Hessian after releasing that constraint. Coarse grids can create unstable directions, so a small residual alone does not establish stability. Domain nucleation, switching speeds and 3D domain morphology are not predicted.
模型用 tᵧ/tₓ 控制跃迁各向异性。能态密度不是电导：输运还要乘 vᵢvⱼ。旋: The ratio tᵧ/tₓ controls hopping anisotropy. Density of states is not conductance: transport also weights vᵢvⱼ. Coordinate rotations must transform both velocity components and tensors; multiplying one representative velocity direction by an irreducible star’s size does not recover the full tensor.
高对称能带路径可以定位简并和交叉，却不能提供体积积分权重。本模块逐点检查完整周期: High-symmetry band paths can locate degeneracies and crossings but do not supply Brillouin-zone integration weights. This module checks a complete periodic mesh and uniform weights point by point. Teaching data come from an independent tight-binding model, not fits to GaAs, Si or other materials.
温度梯度驱动粒子流；开路电场抵消净电流，也改变热流。因此电子热导要扣除 L₁L₀: A temperature gradient drives particle flow; the open-circuit electric field cancels net charge current and changes heat flow. Electronic thermal conductivity therefore subtracts the L₁L₀⁻¹L₁ contribution. The program checks positive semidefiniteness of the covariance and reports significant negative values as numerical problems. Phonon thermal conductivity is absent, so actual material ZT cannot be calculated.
Δ 的两个自旋指标属于一对电子。交换时既转置指标，也把相对动量 k 变为 −k。: The two spin indices of Δ belong to a pair of electrons. Exchange transposes them and reverses relative momentum k→−k. In this single-orbital, spin-rotation-symmetric model, the spin-singlet part is antisymmetric, requiring an even scalar momentum function. The spinless Kitaev chain instead uses odd-momentum pairing. Multiorbital or strong-SOC systems need explicit orbital indices and cannot simply inherit this simplified rule.
取二维方格正交坐标轴。常数和 cos kx+cos ky 属于 A₁g，cos: Use orthogonal axes of a two-dimensional square lattice. Both a constant and cos kx+cos ky belong to A₁g; cos kx−cos ky belongs to B₁g and sin kx sin ky to B₂g, using D₄h even-parity labels. d+id combines B₁g and B₂g complexly and is not one two-dimensional irrep of this point group. Classification specifies transformation laws, not which pairing state wins in a material.
最近邻方格模型的色散由跃迁 t 与化学势 μ 决定。颜色图展示配对函数，深色标记: Nearest-neighbor square-lattice dispersion is set by hopping t and chemical potential μ. The color map shows the pairing function, while dark markers show the normal-state Fermi surface ξ=0. A superconducting zero-energy node must lie in both zero sets; for |μ|>4t, the normal state has no Fermi surface.
每个格点只有一个费米轨道。最近邻配对在动量空间是 sin k 的奇函数，满足交换: Each site has one fermionic orbital. Nearest-neighbor pairing is odd in momentum, with sin k dependence, satisfying exchange antisymmetry. Inputs t,μ,Δ define the model; SOC, Zeeman fields, contacts and disorder of specific nanowires are absent, so this is not a quantitative prediction for an actual material.
极性三阶张量在反演下变号，Oh 中心对称体的电偶极 χ 因而全零。这个结论只针对: A polar third-rank tensor changes sign under inversion, so bulk electric-dipole χ vanishes in centrosymmetric Oh. This applies only to the bulk electric-dipole contribution; surfaces and higher multipoles are outside the calculation. Use Oh as a limiting check rather than treating one zero-intensity curve as experimental proof of inversion.
表面外法向为 +z，散射面为 xz，入射角 θ 相对法向测量。第一字母代表入射偏: The outward surface normal is +z, the scattering plane is xz and incidence angle θ is measured from the normal. The first letter denotes incident polarization and the second the analyzer, so PS means P incident/S outgoing. The sample rotates actively by φ about z. The (001)/(111) presets set initial orientation; for tetragonal (111), the normal also depends on c/a.
把电场变到晶体坐标后求非线性极化，再投影到输出分析器。复系数之间可以相长或相消；: Transform the electric field into crystal coordinates, calculate nonlinear polarization, then project onto the outgoing analyzer. Complex coefficients interfere constructively or destructively; intensities of individual terms cannot be calculated and added first. All four curves share arbitrary units, so tripling every χ must multiply intensity by nine.
4mm (001) 的这个三阶张量几何投影不随 φ 改变，但晶体仍只有四重而不是: This geometric projection of a third-rank tensor for 4mm (001) is independent of φ, although the crystal has only fourfold rather than continuous rotation symmetry. Conversely, different tensors, cuts and coefficients may give similar four-lobed plots. Multiple channels and cuts add constraints but do not guarantee a unique answer without a specified model.
完美链仍有原胞平移对称性，选择较大的计算胞不会改变物理 Hamiltonian。: The perfect chain retains primitive-cell translation symmetry; choosing a larger calculation cell does not change the physical Hamiltonian. A supercell plot has N folded branches, which do not imply new orbitals or a phase transition. The ideal single-orbital primitive dispersion remains ε₀−2t cos k.
展开保留超胞本征能量，计算它在各原胞 Bloch 动量上的投影权重。完美链的合并: Unfolding retains supercell eigenenergies and calculates their projected weights at primitive Bloch momenta. Summed spectral weights of a perfect chain must recover one primitive-cell dispersion even if the solver mixes eigenvectors at degeneracies. Compare perfect and impurity presets to distinguish folding from actual Hamiltonian changes.
在 N=2、K=0 时，c=(1,1)/√2 对 k=0 相长，对 k=π 相消: For N=2, K=0, c=(1,1)/√2 interferes constructively at k=0 and destructively at k=π, giving W(0)=1 and W(π)=0. Replacing it with (1,−1)/√2 exchanges these weights, although both states have identical real-space probabilities. Sitewise probabilities alone are therefore insufficient for unfolding.
对任一归一化本征态，遍历 N 个对应原胞动量的权重和是 1。完整 N 轨道模型中: For a normalized eigenstate, weights summed over its N corresponding primitive momenta equal 1. In a complete N-orbital model, summing over every band at fixed k also gives 1. Actually removing orbitals and retaining M changes the latter to M/N; do not renormalize it away. Individual-state weights inside a degenerate subspace depend on basis, so compare weights summed over equal-energy states.
杂质预设只改变一个格点的在位势；二聚化改变交替键的跃迁；交替势改变两个子晶格的在: The impurity preset changes one onsite potential; dimerization changes alternating-bond hopping; the alternating potential changes the two sublattices’ onsite energies. The vacancy preset actually removes an orbital and its connections. Every defect repeats with supercell periodicity, so an N=4 impurity chain is not an isolated infinitely dilute defect. Similar gaps do not uniquely identify mechanisms.
展开权重反映相对于参考原胞的 Bloch 特征，不等于已经包含光电矩阵元、探测器: Unfolded weights measure Bloch character relative to a reference primitive cell, not ARPES intensity including photoemission matrix elements, detector resolution and surface effects. Imports require normalized complex eigenvectors, orbital positions and phase conventions; energies alone are rejected. Retain parameters, model limits and provenance when comparing concentrations or calculation settings.
沿x的键位于xy镜面内，允许的D垂直于这个镜面；键中心反演要求J对称，禁止全部D: An x-directed bond lies in the xy mirror plane, so allowed D is perpendicular to that plane. Bond-center inversion requires symmetric J and forbids all DMI. The program finds the common solution for selected generators and checks closure of the generated group. Symmetry determines the allowed space, not actual material exchange strengths.
J的迹给出各向同性部分，对称无迹部分给出各向异性，反对称部分对应D·(Si×Sj: The trace of J gives its isotropic part, its symmetric traceless part gives anisotropy, and its antisymmetric part corresponds to D·(Si×Sj). This site uses Jxy−Jyx=2Dz; check this sign convention before comparing references.
本站采用电子电荷−e（e>0）、联络A=i〈u|∂u〉和kx到ky的取向。σxy: This site uses electron charge −e (e>0), Berry connection A=i〈u|∂u〉 and orientation from kx to ky. σxy denotes x current driven by y electric field. Under these definitions, filling a lower band with C=+1 gives negative σxy, consistent with references that instead call σyx the Hall conductance.
QWZ的两条带能量为±s|d|，曲率正好相反。化学势进入上带后，新占据的上带会部: The two QWZ bands have energies ±s|d| and opposite Berry curvatures. When chemical potential enters the upper band, its newly occupied states partly cancel the lower-band curvature contribution. If both bands are empty or both full, the net curvature response of this complete two-band space vanishes.
零温且化学势在直接能隙内时，下带满、上带空，积分只剩下带Chern数。进入能带或: At zero temperature with chemical potential inside the direct gap, the lower band is full and the upper empty, leaving the lower-band Chern number in the integral. Entering a band or heating gives occupations that no longer fill a complete isolated band, so response is generally unquantized. A two-dimensional sheet response needs no arbitrary vacuum thickness.
已有FHS课堂强调离散Chern整数，而本页直接对曲率做求积。每次运行比较N×N: The existing FHS lesson emphasizes discrete Chern integers, whereas this page directly integrates curvature. Every run compares N×N and 2N×2N meshes and checks the curvature integral against the analytical lower-band Chern number. Each μ-scan point has its own stability indicator; a passing selected point does not establish that every scan point passes.
在m=−2、0、2处，即使奇数网格漏掉退化动量，解析间隙仍为零。本实现停止报告依: At m=−2,0,2, the analytical gap is zero even if an odd mesh misses the degenerate momentum. This implementation therefore stops reporting responses that require isolated bands. It does not declare every gapless material’s physical Hall effect undefined; this is a limitation of the current algorithm.
bcc Fe可作为磁性金属的材料背景，学习SOC避免交叉附近的曲率热点和积分收敛: bcc Fe provides magnetic-metal context for learning about curvature hotspots near SOC-induced avoided crossings and integration convergence. These QWZ parameters are not fitted to Fe. Complete Wannier responses also need position/connection matrices, orbital embedding and conventions; one hr file is not automatically all the Berry information.
每个站点允许空、仅↑、仅↓、↑↓四种局域状态。同自旋不能占据同一个轨道；反自旋可: Each site permits four local states: empty, ↑, ↓ and ↑↓. Identical spins cannot occupy the same orbital, while opposite spins may doubly occupy it at energy cost U. Single band here means one spatial orbital per site, not spinless electrons.
跃迁不翻转自旋，因此 N_{↑}、N_{↓}分别守恒。固定扇区的维数是两种自旋选: Hopping does not flip spin, so N_{↑} and N_{↓} are separately conserved. A fixed-sector dimension is the product of the site-choice counts for the two spins. The dimer (1,1) sector has four occupation-number basis states; the four-site (2,2) sector has 36, small enough to calculate every eigenvalue.
两个电子分居两站点时，单重态能通过跃迁与双占据组态混合，降低能量；三重态受到自旋: When two electrons occupy separate sites, hopping mixes a singlet with doubly occupied configurations and lowers its energy; the triplet is constrained by spin and fermionic antisymmetry. The symmetric dimer’s triplet energy is zero, while its lowest singlet lies below zero for t>0.
本实验专门比较 N=2 二聚体的最低 S=0 与 S=1 能量。Δ=0 时有解析: This experiment compares the lowest S=0 and S=1 energies of the N=2 dimer. At Δ=0 an analytical expression exists. Only for U≫t does virtual double occupancy cost approximately U, giving 4t²/U. At U=0, the exact splitting is 2t and the large-U approximation is inapplicable.
能谱来自输入的 (N_{↑},N_{↓}) 扇区，因此固定N与S^z。扇区激发隙: The spectrum comes from the input (N_{↑},N_{↓}) sector, fixing both N and S^z. Its sector excitation gap compares the ground energy with the next level above the whole degenerate ground subspace. It need not be the lowest excitation across all spin sectors and is not automatically a charge gap. With only one distinct energy level, this gap is undefined.
内部从i=0编号，首站点的位能为+Δ/2，第二站点为−Δ/2。因此正Δ倾向把电子: Internal indexing starts at i=0: the first site has onsite energy +Δ/2 and the second −Δ/2. Positive Δ favors moving electrons to the second site, while U opposes their simultaneous double occupancy there. Total-number conservation alone does not reveal this redistribution; compare site densities and double occupancy.
八重态算符作用于八重态初态时，有两个到八重态末态的约化通道。是否发生、强度多大，: An octet operator acting on an octet initial state has two reduced coupling channels to an octet final state. Whether a transition occurs and its strength still depend on dynamics and other quantum numbers. Total exchange symmetry of identical particles must also include spin and spatial parts.
自然坐标中的单态系数全为 +1/√3；按 GT 基底定义，三个非零坐标为 +1/: The singlet has coefficients all +1/√3 in natural coordinates; with the GT basis convention, its three nonzero coordinates are +1/√3,−1/√3,+1/√3. The initial state |u,ū⟩ has singlet probability 1/3.
新副本概率各为 1/2，总概率仍为 1；交换矩阵变为 [[0,−1],[−1,0: The new copy probabilities are each 1/2 and still sum to 1. The exchange matrix becomes [[0,−1],[−1,0]], preserving exchange expectation +1. This experiment keeps the 8s/8a exchange eigenbasis by default; the exercise demonstrates another valid copy-basis transformation.
总维数等于输入乘积维数。输出 (3,2) 的标签和为 5，仍合法；p+q≤4 是: The total dimension equals the input product dimension. Output label (3,2) has sum 5 and remains valid: p+q≤4 limits input factors. A complete CG calculation must also construct every GT column in each channel.
三个通道为 (3,2)、(1,3)、(2,1)，外重数各为 1，维数为 42、2: The three channels are (3,2),(1,3),(2,1), each of outer multiplicity 1, with dimensions 42,24,15. N=81 satisfies the exact-mode dimension limit; output labels may exceed input-label bounds.
这一子块已通过归一化、正交与一个升算符条件。完整 CG 计算还要使用剩余权空间和: This subblock passes normalization, orthogonality and one raising-operator condition. A complete CG calculation must also use the remaining weight spaces and intertwining relations for every generator. A successful local subblock does not prove the complete matrix.
右坐标为 (i/2,1/2+i√2/4,1/2−i√2/4)ᵀ，概率为 (1/4: Right-hand coordinates are (i/2,1/2+i√2/4,1/2−i√2/4)ᵀ, with probabilities (1/4,3/8,3/8). The exact inverse basis change recovers (1,i,0)ᵀ/√2.
8⁴ 中 m_1=8、m_8=32、m_27=33，对应同型维数 8、256、8: In 8⁴, m_1=8, m_8=32 and m_27=33 give isotypic dimensions 8,256,891. The final-27 R matrix has 17 eigenvalues +1 and 16 eigenvalues −1, hence trace 1.
BCD 的全对称 10 和全反对称 1 均不能与 A=10 耦合成最终 8。只剩: Neither the fully symmetric 10 nor the fully antisymmetric 1 of BCD can couple with A=10 to final 8. Only the two-copy 8 remains; its copy space is the two-dimensional standard representation of S₃. The outer multiplicity of 10⊗8→8 is one.
右路径中按 G 赋予对应能值；左路径一般不是该作用的本征基底。用同一个 R 对算: Assign each right path its energy according to G; left paths generally are not eigenvectors of this interaction. Conjugating the operator with the same R checks real expectation values and second moments. Numerical values depend on the preset’s e₁,e₂ and exact R.
第 3.6–3.7 节的 SU(2) 张量积与 Clebsch–Gordan 约: Sections 3.6–3.7 give SU(2) tensor products and Clebsch–Gordan conventions; Sections 7.3–7.6 cover SU(3) representations and tensor products. The Casimir normalization in Section 7.3.3 differs from this course; convert to Tₐ=λₐ/2 before comparing.
Physics Letters B 845, 138138 (2023)，第 2: Physics Letters B 845, 138138 (2023), Section 2.1, Eqs. (2.4)–(2.5). Used to check multiplicity-space maps and normalization by the square root of the two intermediate-representation dimensions. This course takes the ordinary-group q→1 limit and ordinary dimensions; quantum groups and braid groups are not calculated.
只考察平面内的正旋转，正方形允许 0°、90°、180°、270°，构成四元素群: Considering only proper in-plane rotations, a square allows 0°,90°,180°,270°, forming the four-element group C₄. An ideal disk permits every angle, forming SO(2). Both obey group multiplication rules, but the latter permits continuous motion in angle from the identity.
二能级态写作 ψ=(a,b)ᵀ，a、b 是复振幅。归一化条件是 |a|²+|b|: Write a two-level state as ψ=(a,b)ᵀ with complex amplitudes a,b. Normalization requires |a|²+|b|²=1; in the chosen basis, measurement probabilities are |a|² and |b|². Complex conjugation sends i to −i; conjugate transpose † additionally exchanges rows and columns.
U(n) 是所有 n×n 酉矩阵。SU(n) 再要求 det U=1；S 表示: U(n) consists of all n×n unitary matrices. SU(n) additionally requires det U=1; S means special and U unitary. n counts complex-vector components in the fundamental representation, not the dimension of the group.
酉矩阵的行列式模长为 1，但可以带相位。要求行列式恰好等于 1 是额外限制。数值: A unitary matrix’s determinant has modulus 1 but may carry a phase. Requiring the determinant to equal exactly 1 is an additional restriction. Numerical calculations report unitarity and determinant errors; small floating-point errors are not new physical effects.
严格的实李代数 su(n) 由无迹反厄米矩阵 X 构成，这里 X=−iT。不要直: The real Lie algebra su(n) consists of traceless anti-Hermitian matrices X, with X=−iT here. Hermitian matrices are not closed under ordinary matrix commutators: the commutator of two Hermitian matrices is anti-Hermitian, which is why physics formulas explicitly contain i.
对易子 [A,B]=AB−BA 检查两种次序的差。矩阵作用在列向量上时，ABψ: The commutator [A,B]=AB−BA compares the two operation orders. For column vectors, ABψ applies B first, then A. If [A,B]=0, exponentials of that generator pair commute as well; in general, exp(A)exp(B) cannot be combined directly into exp(A+B).
交互实验可比较两对生成元：SU(2) 的 Tx、Ty 不对易，而 SU(3) 的: The interactive experiment compares two generator pairs: SU(2) Tx and Ty do not commute, while SU(3) T3 and T8 do. A zero commutator means no order dependence for that pair, not that the whole group is Abelian.
SU(2) 基本表示作用在 ψ=(a,b)ᵀ∈ℂ² 上。自旋 1/2 的角动量算: The SU(2) fundamental representation acts on ψ=(a,b)ᵀ∈ℂ². Spin-1/2 angular momentum is Sa=ℏσa/2; the course separates ℏ and uses dimensionless generators Ta=σa/2. The group dimension is 3, while the fundamental-representation dimension is 2: these are different concepts.
归一化纯态的 Bloch 向量 r=(⟨σx⟩,⟨σy⟩,⟨σz⟩) 长度为 1: A normalized pure state has unit Bloch vector r=(⟨σx⟩,⟨σy⟩,⟨σz⟩). Spin expectation is ⟨S⟩=(ℏ/2)r. |↑z⟩=(1,0)ᵀ lies at the north pole, while (1,1)ᵀ/√2 points along +x.
用 U(r·σ)U† 定义旋转后的向量，可以得到 R(U)∈SO(3)。把 U: Define the rotated vector through U(r·σ)U† to obtain R(U)∈SO(3). Replacing U by −U cancels the two minus signs and leaves R unchanged. Every three-dimensional proper rotation therefore has two preimages ±U, with kernel {I,−I}.
对晶体的有限正旋转子群，可以取它在 SU(2) 中的原像，保留代表 2π 回转的: For a crystal’s finite subgroup of proper rotations, take its preimage in SU(2) and retain the central element representing a 2π rotation. This introduces double-valued representations and double groups. Point groups containing inversion or mirrors additionally need representations of those operations; SU(2)→SO(3) alone does not cover them.
表示 D 把每个群元素变成作用在向量空间上的线性变换，并满足 D(g₁g₂)=D: A representation D maps every group element to a linear transformation of a vector space, satisfying D(g₁g₂)=D(g₁)D(g₂). One group can have many representations. Representation dimension counts components of the vectors acted upon and cannot be inferred from the group’s name alone.
若存在一个非零、非整个空间的子空间，被所有 D(g) 保持，就称表示可约。只对角: A representation is reducible if a nonzero proper subspace is invariant under every D(g). Diagonalizing one generator alone does not decompose the representation; one must find subspaces invariant under all group operations simultaneously.
中心元素 −I 在自旋 j 表示中作用为 (−1)^(2j)。整数 j 中它为: The central element −I acts in spin j as (−1)^(2j). For integer j this is +I, allowing the representation to descend to an ordinary SO(3) representation. For half-integer j, the two elements ±U cannot be identified.
SU(2) 的三维表示和 SU(3) 的三维基本表示虽然分量数相同，作用的群与生: The three-dimensional SU(2) representation and three-dimensional SU(3) fundamental representation have the same component count, but their acting groups and numbers of generators differ. SU(3) is not SO(3) or a more complete version of 3D crystal rotations. SU(3) can describe some ideal three-level controls; an actual material symmetry still requires a Hamiltonian check.
选择标准 Gell-Mann 矩阵 λ₁…λ₈，取 Tₐ=λₐ/2。它们满足 T: Choose standard Gell-Mann matrices λ₁…λ₈ and Tₐ=λₐ/2, satisfying Tr(TₐTᵦ)=δₐᵦ/2. Rows and columns correspond to basis states |1⟩,|2⟩,|3⟩, not the spatial axes x,y,z.
这个坐标平面属于表示论，不是实空间或倒空间。它不直接给出晶格位置、布里渊区路径或: This coordinate plane belongs to representation theory, not real or reciprocal space. It does not directly give lattice positions, Brillouin-zone paths or material energy levels. Applying SU(3) to a real system requires an additional Hamiltonian and experimental assumptions.
核磁共振中的选定自旋跃迁、原子的两个能级以及量子电路中的量子比特，都可在合适条件: Selected nuclear-magnetic-resonance transitions, two atomic levels and circuit qubits can approximate two-level systems under suitable conditions. Here |↑⟩=(1,0)ᵀ and |↓⟩=(0,1)ᵀ; arrows label a basis rather than automatically specifying which real energy is higher.
从 |↑⟩ 出发，横向驱动提供上下态之间的混合；失谐把旋转轴向 z 方向倾斜。因: Starting from |↑⟩, a transverse drive mixes the two states, while detuning tilts the rotation axis toward z. Probability oscillations may become faster without achieving complete inversion. For Ω=Δ=0 there is no evolution, and the transition-probability formula takes its continuous-limit value zero.
这是恒定有效场、无退相干和无泄漏的模型。真实脉冲还受有限带宽、其他能级、噪声与旋: This model has a constant effective field, no decoherence and no leakage. Real pulses also depend on finite bandwidth, other levels, noise and rotating-wave-approximation errors. Curves explain control mechanisms and are not direct device calibrations.
按 |↑↑⟩、|↑↓⟩、|↓↑⟩、|↓↓⟩ 排列乘积基底。最大 M=1 的 |↑: Order the product basis |↑↑⟩,|↑↓⟩,|↓↑⟩,|↓↓⟩. The maximal-M=1 state |↑↑⟩ must have J=1. Applying the total lowering operator gives the symmetric M=0 combination; lowering again gives |↓↓⟩, completing the triplet.
剩余正交组合是 J=0 单重态。单重态在共同旋转 U⊗U 下不变；三重态三个分量: The remaining orthogonal combination is the J=0 singlet. It is invariant under common rotations U⊗U, while the three triplet components mix. Under this course’s phase convention, the |↑↓⟩ singlet coefficient is positive.
定义无量纲 s⃗₁、s⃗₂，取 H=κ s⃗₁·s⃗₂，其中 κ 具有能量单位；: Define dimensionless s⃗₁,s⃗₂ and H=κ s⃗₁·s⃗₂, with energy-unit κ. Reserve J for total-angular-momentum quantum number to avoid confusing it with exchange constants. From J⃗=s⃗₁+s⃗₂, expanding the square gives every J-subspace energy without evaluating a fourth-order determinant.
κ>0 时单重态较低，称此符号约定下的反铁磁交换；κ<0 时三重态较低。理想各向: For κ>0 the singlet is lower, defining antiferromagnetic exchange under this sign convention; for κ<0 the triplet is lower. Ideal isotropic exchange preserves degeneracy of the three triplet components; fields or anisotropy can change this.
单重态的每个自旋单独测量都没有确定方向，却具有关联；它不是固定的两支反平行经典箭: Each singlet spin measured separately has no definite direction, yet the spins are correlated; they are not two fixed antiparallel classical arrows. Indistinguishable electrons must combine spatial, spin and other degrees of freedom into a fully antisymmetric wavefunction. Spin alone cannot determine whether the complete state is allowed.
对于 (1,0)，d=3、C₂=4/3；对于 (1,1)，d=8、C₂=3。C₂: For (1,0), d=3 and C₂=4/3; for (1,1), d=8 and C₂=3. C₂ is dimensionless group-theory data, not automatically energy. The representations 3 and 3̄ have equal C₂, so the quadratic Casimir alone cannot distinguish all representations.
张量积中，Cartan 算符为 T⊗I+I⊗T，所以两个因子的权相加；若多个态给: In a tensor product, a Cartan operator acts as T⊗I+I⊗T, so factor weights add. If multiple states share coordinates, add their multiplicities. Successively remove complete irreducible weight systems generated by highest weights to obtain the direct-sum decomposition. The plot’s outer outline alone misses internal states.
色 SU(3) 是 QCD 的局域规范结构，三个分量是色指标，不是三种味。每种味: Color SU(3) is QCD’s local gauge structure; its three components are color indices, not three flavors. Every flavor carries color, and flavor-dependent quark masses preserve color gauge invariance. Color-singlet and flavor-singlet conditions differ; gauge redundancy is not an ordinary observable spatial rotation.
导入文件后显示能级、简并度与表示分解。: After import, display energy levels, degeneracies and representation decompositions.
保持两自旋1/2、初态↑↓，先用CG振幅分解为单重态与M=0三重态，再由交换能级: Keep two spin-1/2 particles initially in ↑↓. Use CG amplitudes to decompose the state into the singlet and M=0 triplet, then derive their relative phase from the exchange splitting.
用具体 U、t 和能量解释相互作用，并说明统计条件本身不能决定能量。: Explain interactions in terms of specific U, t, and energy, and show that statistical conditions alone do not determine energy.
零净绕数不证明内部无缺陷；环路过核心时不报告整数。: Zero net winding does not prove that the interior is defect-free; no integer is reported when the loop crosses a core.
八维表示有两个E副本，每份有两个伙伴；E投影秩为4。副本耦合矩阵可非对角，但母群: The eight-dimensional representation has two E copies, each with two partners, giving E-projector rank 4. Copy coupling can be off-diagonal, but preserving the parent group makes it proportional to the identity in partner space. Copy-energy separation is not E-partner splitting.
For the line model, additionally specify fine spacing a/2, A at even j, B at odd j and V/E₀=0.3f. This extra coupling assumption gives mτ_z⊗I; it is not an automatic structural fit of the electronic Hamiltonian.
区分法向边界与面内周期，报告层数和切面。: Distinguish the nonperiodic normal boundary from in-plane periodicity; report layer count and surface cut.
